account:link.title: Email
account:link.title__note: Short email-linking screen header; must fit at 200% text. The body explains linking.
account:link.body: Add an email address to sign in to this account.
account:link.body__note: Phase 1 claim review, 2026-09-13. Describe current practice/account availability without promising retention, complete world coverage or cross-device recovery. Keep ICU placeholders unchanged.
account:link.assure.travels: Use a code sent to your email
account:link.assure.travels__note: Phase 1 claim review, 2026-09-13. Describe current practice/account availability without promising retention, complete world coverage or cross-device recovery. Keep ICU placeholders unchanged.
account:link.assure.anyPhone: Progress recovery is still being tested
account:link.assure.anyPhone__note: Phase 1 claim review, 2026-09-13. Describe current practice/account availability without promising retention, complete world coverage or cross-device recovery. Keep ICU placeholders unchanged.
account:link.assure.onlyUse: We use your email to sign you in, and for nothing else
account:link.assure.onlyUse__note: Third of three, and the one people hesitate over — keep the promise exact and do not add claims the product has not made. A phrase, no full stop. Max 60 characters.
account:step__note: Spoken name of the two-step progress bar on the account flow: address, then code. Never shown as text — the bar itself carries the count.
account:signIn.title: Sign in
account:signIn.title__note: Screen title for returning to an existing account. Max 16 characters.
account:signIn.body: Enter the email you saved your progress with and we will send you a code.
account:signIn.warning.title: There is progress on this phone
account:signIn.warning.title__note: Heading of the warning shown when signing in would strand unsaved local progress. States a fact, never scolds. Max 40 characters.
account:signIn.warning.body: {count, plural, one {You have a # day streak here that is not saved to an account. Signing in switches to your other account and leaves this behind.} other {You have a # day streak here that is not saved to an account. Signing in switches to your other account and leaves this behind.}}
account:signIn.warning.body__note: The specific number is the point — a person stops and reads 'your 14 day streak' and taps past 'you may lose data'.
account:signIn.warning.cta__note: Switches to the link flow, which keeps what is on this phone. Max 30 characters.
account:email.label: Email
account:email.label__note: Spoken label of the email field. Max 12 characters.
account:email.placeholder__note: Placeholder in the email field. Use an address that reads as an example in your language.
account:email.cta__note: Submits the email address. Max 20 characters.
account:code.body: We sent a six-digit code to {email}. It expires in an hour.
account:code.body__note: Naming the address is what makes a typo findable at a glance. Max 80 characters.
account:code.label: Six-digit code
account:code.label__note: Spoken label of the code field. Max 20 characters.
account:code.placeholder__note: Placeholder in the code field. Digits only — keep it six characters.
account:code.wrongEmail__note: Goes back to the address field. Max 26 characters.
account:done.link.title: Your email is linked
account:done.link.title__note: Phase 1 claim review, 2026-09-13. Describe current practice/account availability without promising retention, complete world coverage or cross-device recovery. Keep ICU placeholders unchanged.
account:done.link.body: You can now use this email to sign in to your account.
account:done.link.body__note: Phase 1 claim review, 2026-09-13. Describe current practice/account availability without promising retention, complete world coverage or cross-device recovery. Keep ICU placeholders unchanged.
account:done.signIn.title: Welcome back
account:done.signIn.title__note: Shown after signing in on a new device. Max 24 characters.
account:done.signIn.body: You are signed in to your account.
account:done.signIn.body__note: Phase 1 claim review, 2026-09-13. Describe current practice/account availability without promising retention, complete world coverage or cross-device recovery. Keep ICU placeholders unchanged.
account:done.cta__note: Leaves the account screen. Max 20 characters.
account:error.noAccount: We have no account for that email. Check the spelling, or save this phone's progress instead.
account:error.noAccount__note: Shown when signing in with an address that has never been used. Naming both fixes matters — the address is usually just mistyped.
account:error.badCode: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
account:error.badCode__note: Wrong or expired six-digit code. No blame, no attempt counter. Max 70 characters.
account:error.taken: That email is already on another account. Sign in with it instead.
account:error.taken__note: Shown when linking an address that belongs to someone else's account. Max 80 characters.
account:error.generic: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.
account:error.generic__note: Anything we cannot name. Never shows a raw error to the user. Max 70 characters.
account:settings.email__note: Settings row label; the address is shown beside it. Max 20 characters.
account:settings.anonymous__note: Settings row label when nothing is saved. A fact, not a warning. Max 20 characters.
account:settings.link__note: Phase 1 claim review, 2026-09-13. Describe current practice/account availability without promising retention, complete world coverage or cross-device recovery. Keep ICU placeholders unchanged.
account:settings.signIn__note: Settings row that opens the sign-in flow. Max 30 characters.
account:settings.signOut__note: Ends the session and clears this device. Max 16 characters.
account:settings.signOut.unsynced: {count, plural, one {# lesson has not reached the server yet} other {# lessons have not reached the server yet}}. Sign back into this account on this device to sync.
account:settings.signOut.unsynced__note: Shown before sign-out when this account has queued lessons. Work stays on this device in its original account namespace. A different account cannot send it. ICU plural.
account:settings.signOut.anyway__note: Sign-out button beside pending-work notice. Same action as ordinary sign-out; work is detached and preserved.
account:settings.child: Progress on this phone stays on this phone. Ask a grown-up if you want to keep it somewhere safe.
account:settings.child__note: Shown instead of the account rows on an under-13 account, where we must not collect an email address. Plain words a ten-year-old reads without alarm.
account:offline.title: You are offline
account:offline.title__note: Shown on the account screen with no connection. This is the one flow in the app that cannot work offline. Max 24 characters.
account:offline.body: Linking an email needs a connection. Come back when you are online.
account:offline.body__note: Phase 1 claim review, 2026-09-13. Describe current practice/account availability without promising retention, complete world coverage or cross-device recovery. Keep ICU placeholders unchanged.
account:settings.signOut.pending__note: Status while protected credentials are being removed. The action cannot be repeated until cleanup finishes.
account:settings.signOut.failed: Sign-out could not finish on this device. Unlock your phone and tap Sign out to try again.
account:settings.signOut.failed__note: Protected credential cleanup failed. Keep Settings open and offer the existing sign-out action as retry; never claim credentials were erased.
account:ask.title: Create a profile
account:ask.title__note: Heading of the full screen offered to an adult guest after one of their first two finished lessons. Names what the button does; never a warning. Max 24 characters.
account:ask.body: Your progress is saved on this phone. With a profile, you can sign in to it again.
account:ask.body__note: Why a profile is worth having, as what it does today. Must fit with the privacy line at 200 % text on a small phone. Must not promise moving progress to a new phone until second-device recovery (U04) is verified; never a threat of losing progress.
account:ask.privacy: We use your email to sign you in, and for nothing else.
account:ask.privacy__note: Small reassurance under the body — the promise people hesitate over. Keep it exact and add no claims the product has not made. Max 60 characters.
account:ask.create__note: Primary button. Opens the screen that links an email address. Verb first. Max 20 characters.
account:ask.later__note: Leaves the ask and carries on. NOT 'No thanks' or 'Skip': nothing is being refused, and it may be offered once more after the next lesson. Max 12 characters.
account:mail.link.subject: Your WorldQuest code
account:mail.link.subject__note: Subject of the email that links progress to an address. Short; no emoji.
account:mail.link.body: Enter this code in WorldQuest to save your progress to this email address:
account:mail.link.body__note: First line of the link email, above the code.
account:mail.login.subject: Your WorldQuest sign-in code
account:mail.login.body: Enter this code in WorldQuest to sign in:
account:mail.login.body__note: First line of the sign-in email, above the code.
account:mail.delete.subject: Confirm deleting your WorldQuest account
account:mail.delete.subject__note: Subject of the email that confirms account deletion. Plain; no alarm.
account:mail.delete.body: Enter this code in WorldQuest to confirm deleting your account and its progress:
account:mail.delete.body__note: First line of the deletion email, above the code.
account:mail.expiry__note: Under the code. The five minutes is the server rule (emailOTP expiresIn 300s); change both together.
account:mail.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email.
account:mail.ignore__note: Last line. Reassuring, no call to action.
